scenarios.name: Junk Pocket
scenarios.subtitle: Floor 01 junk-choked pocket: one lair, two piles, a closed far door
scenarios.purpose: A 1056 px scrolling pocket with one continuous ground lane: a protected entry pocket, a 48 px junk bank on the lane that both heroes clear with an ordinary jump, an open arena for the committed boss attacks, a hanging stack bay at the right, and a protected exit pocket behind a door that is closed until the boss is defeated.
scenarios.expected: The bank, the support post, the boss and the door come from f01_hoarder.encounter.json; this file holds geometry only. The lane ceiling is declared because the bank top is above the DP-Q45 free height.
scenarios.coop: Solo with a swap, or two players: every critical route is open to Carl's 80 px class; no Donut-only gate and no raised surface above 48 px.
